layout_arrow.scientific_relations: preserve original arrows, tree/network edges and meaningful dashed or feedback relations

figure_acquisition.background_and_frontier: Follow relevant Introduction references to original scholarly figures.
figure_acquisition.methods: Use original figures or source-supported editable schematics of actual inputs, model stages, outputs and validation.
figure_acquisition.results: Use the focal paper's figures and verified data.
figure_acquisition.discussion: Include external-study figures and compare systems, response variables, scale and methods.
figure_acquisition.proposals: Visualize proposed designs separately from observed evidence; never fabricate results.

selection_rule: Establish background, related work and research gap before methods/results. Select varied layouts by the actual argument, evidence and capacity. Section names are narrative roles, not mandatory renderer layout IDs.
